scripts.text:
- A person with a white gown -
- is pulling at his hair. -
scripts.translation:
- 一名身穿白袍的人 -
- 正在抓着自己的头发。 -

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Aaaarrrggghh!!!
Darn it!!!!
I'm finished!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
啊啊啊啊！！
可恶！！
我完蛋了！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
How am I supposed to submit a report that's so bad!!! A 5-year-old could do better!!!
Noooo!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
这么糟糕的报告，我怎么交得出去！！！五岁小孩写得都比我好！！！
不啊！！！

scripts.text:
- A person with a white gown -
- is pulling at his hair. -
scripts.translation:
- 一名身穿白袍的人 -
- 正在抓着自己的头发。 -

scripts.text: Try talking to him.
scripts.translation: 去和他谈谈。

scripts.text: How noisy.
scripts.translation: 真吵。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Oh, of course, I'm sorry.
I'll keep it down.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
啊，抱歉。
我会小声点。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sir... Are you okay?
You will lose all your hair like that.
Calm down.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先生...你还好吗？
再这么抓下去，头发都要掉光了。
冷静点。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Sob.......
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
.......

[Theore]
Odin!!!
Freyja!!!!
Sazarim!!!
Thank you!!
It's not all over!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
奥丁！！！
弗蕾雅！！！！
萨扎林！！！
谢谢你们！！
我还有救！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
There's always hope! I, Theore, will persevere and go on!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
希望还在！我，西奥雷，一定会坚持到底！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Dear Adventurer!!!
No, no, dear Warrior!!!!
Are you busy at the moment?
If you spare me a little time, I will see to it that you're rewarded handsomely!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
亲爱的冒险者！！！
不，不，亲爱的勇士！！！！
你现在有空吗？
只要肯抽空帮我，我一定给你丰厚的报酬！

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text: Listen to him more.
scripts.translation: 继续听他说。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
.......
I see, I suppose it can't be helped.
I'll probably lose all my hair and be on the ad for hair growth solutions. But I won't hold it against you, Warrior.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
...
我明白了，也是没办法的事。
我大概会掉光头发，只好去拍生发产品广告了。不过我不会怪你的，勇士。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Dear God! My luck ends here. *sob*
Even though the world is turning its back on me, I won't blame anyone!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
天哪！我的好运到此为止了。呜...
就算全世界都抛弃我，我也不会怪任何人！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Ahhh!
I feel like I was saved.
So the thing is.......
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
啊！
我感觉自己得救了。
事情是这样的...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Oh! Oh dear!
How rude of me, I haven't even introduced myself.
My name is Theore, and I work for 'Bazett Teablack's Institute of Culture of the Other World.'
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
哦！哎呀！
真失礼，我还没自我介绍呢。
我叫西奥雷，在“巴泽特·茶黑异界文化研究所”工作。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
I'm currently working on researching Laphines in the Splendide Basecamp.
Might be because I've been working soooo hard, but these days the Laphines all run away as soon as they see me.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
我目前在辉煌领域营地研究拉菲尼。
也许是我最近太拼命了，现在拉菲尼一看见我就拔腿逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
The deadline is approaching, and I still haven't figured out the most critical part. 
My professor will be very disappointed .......
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
截止日期快到了，可我还没弄清楚最关键的部分。
导师肯定会很失望...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
So won't you give me a hand?!
Your help will be acknowledged fully - I will tell the professor myself!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
所以，你能帮我一把吗？！
我一定会好好感谢你——还会亲自向导师说明你的功劳！

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙。

scripts.text: Don't help.
scripts.translation: 不帮。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Sob sob Warrior, you're the best!
I will not forget this!!!
I'm going to write about it in my diary!!
And in the report!!!
And in a letter I'm sending home!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
呜呜，勇士，你真是太好了！
我永远不会忘记！！！
我要把这件事写进日记！！
还要写进报告里！！！
也要写进寄回家的信里！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
I'll tell my buddies at the lab!!!
I'll tell Lugen!!!
I'll write it in the bulletin board!!!
Let's see!!! Where else?
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
我要告诉实验室的同事！！！
还要告诉卢根！！！
我要把这事贴到布告栏上！！！
让我想想！！！还有谁？

scripts.text:
- The man seems to be in a manic state. -
- Wait until he calms down -
- and try speaking to him again. -
scripts.translation:
- 这个男人似乎兴奋得有些失控。 -
- 等他冷静下来 -
- 再试着和他交谈。 -

scripts.text:
[Theore]
.......
You bad person, making me all worked up.
*sob*
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
...
你真过分，害我这么激动。
呜...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
......

[Theore]
......
Tell the people around here!!!
Shout it out loud from the observatory so the whole world hears!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
...
我要告诉这附近所有人！！！
还要站在观测台上大声喊，让全世界都听见！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
......
Tell Mr. Holgren!!!
Write up a report for the King!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
...
我要告诉霍尔格伦先生！！！
还要给国王写报告！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
......
Tell the merchant across the street!!!
And also tell the administrator!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
...
我要告诉街对面的商人！！！
还有管理员！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
......
I must tell my next-door neighbor Pico!!!
And Kachua!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
...
我要告诉隔壁的皮科！！！
还有卡楚阿！！！

scripts.text:
- He is still manic. -
- Wait until he calms down -
- and try speaking to him again. -
scripts.translation:
- 他仍然兴奋得有些失控。 -
- 等他冷静下来 -
- 再试着和他交谈。 -

scripts.text:
[Theore]
My apologies.
I got a little excited.
I do apologize.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
抱歉。
我刚才有点太激动了。
实在对不起。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
I'm usually a calm and rational person, but it feels like I've been everywhere - heaven AND hell - today!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
我平时明明很冷静理智，可今天感觉简直像是上了天堂又下了地狱！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
To the point: what I would like to ask you is not a hard task.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
言归正传，我想拜托你的事并不难。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
As you probably know, the Laphines are at war with the Saphas.
Until recently, they attacked the Saphas mercilessly.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
你大概知道，拉菲尼和萨法正在交战。
直到最近，拉菲尼还在无情地攻击萨法。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
But lately, the frequency of attacks has decreased significantly.
I can't figure out why, they are single-minded creatures and it's not likely that they just took pity on the Saphas' situation.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
可最近攻击次数明显减少了。
我实在想不通原因。拉菲尼做事一根筋，应该不会突然同情起处境艰难的萨法吧。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Also, there are rumors of unarmed Laphines flying through the fields.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
还有传闻说，有些没带武器的拉菲尼会飞过田野。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
I have seen it once, but he ran away as soon as he spotted me and I didn't get a chance to ask him.
I'm sure that he went back to the village. But as desperately as I want to ask, I was banned from entering the Splendide Basecamp.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
我曾亲眼见过一次，可它一发现我就跑了，我根本来不及问。
我敢肯定它回了村子。可我被禁止进入辉煌领域营地，再想问也没办法。

scripts.text: Banned?
scripts.translation: 被禁止进入？

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Well...
I got so excited after the professor assigned me to this research project.......
that I combed through Splendide night and day, and they finally kicked me out.
Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
唉...导师把这个研究项目交给我时，我实在太兴奋了...
结果我日夜在辉煌领域四处搜查，他们终于把我赶了出来。哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
The Laphines may look cute, but they are combat specialists.......
So here I am, without the courage to sneak in, but with the report half-finished.......
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
拉菲尼看起来是很可爱，可它们都是战斗专家...
所以我现在既没胆子偷偷溜进去，报告也只写了一半...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Tell me, is there a life more unfortunate than mine?
*chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
你说，还有比我更倒霉的人吗？
*苦笑*

scripts.text:
[Theore]
So Warrior, would you please find the Laphines who are coming to the Splendide field, and find out what they're up to?
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
勇士，能不能帮我找到那些来到辉煌领域原野的拉菲尼，查清楚它们在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Theore]
They may run away if you try to speak to them, so pay close attention when you find one.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
你一靠近，它们可能就会逃跑。找到后一定要留心观察。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
The Laphines are such a rowdy crew, and it's very unsettling to see how quiet they've been - almost like a period of calm before a giant thunderstorm.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
拉菲尼平时吵吵闹闹的，可最近却安静得反常，简直像暴风雨来临前的平静。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
So Warrior, would you please find the Laphines who are coming to the Splendide field, and ask them what they're up to?
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
勇士，能不能帮我找到那些来到辉煌领域原野的拉菲尼，问问它们在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Theore]
They may run away if you try to speak to them, so pay close attention when you find one.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
你一靠近，它们可能就会逃跑。找到后一定要留心观察。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
The Laphines are such a rowdy crew, and it's very unsettling to see how quiet they've been - almost like a period of calm before a giant thunderstorm.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
拉菲尼平时吵吵闹闹的，可最近却安静得反常，简直像暴风雨来临前的平静。

scripts.text: - He is in no state for conversations. You should take the pouch to Splendide and look for its owner. -
scripts.translation: - 他现在没法交谈。你应该把这个小袋子带去辉煌领域，找找它的主人。 -

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Hmm...... They were rummaging through the bushes?
Hmm... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
嗯...它们在灌木丛里翻找东西？
嗯...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
They may have left a clue, can you please look around the area?
If they were looking through the bushes, they may have been looking for something they've lost.
Or they may have left something behind.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
它们可能留下了线索。能帮我找找附近吗？
如果它们一直在灌木丛里翻找，或许是在找丢失的东西。
也可能是不小心留下了什么。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
They may have left a clue, can you please look around the area?
If they were looking through the bushes, they may have been looking for something they've lost.
Or they may have left something behind.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
它们可能留下了线索。能帮我找找附近吗？
如果它们一直在灌木丛里翻找，或许是在找丢失的东西。
也可能是不小心留下了什么。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
A pouch that a Laphine dropped as it fled?
Hmm... Hmm... A soft leather pouch with a string made by soaking dried vines in oil.... too small for humans or Saphas to use...
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
这是拉菲尼逃跑时掉下的小袋子？
嗯...嗯...柔软的皮袋，还系着用油浸过的干藤条编成的细绳...袋子太小，人类和萨法都用不了...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Could... Could it be??!!
that object?!
that I've only heard about, but never came across!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
难...难道是那个？！
那个我只听说过、却从没见过的东西！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
In the ancient times, Laphines used to carry fairy dust - such as the flying dust, minimizing dust - in a small pouch like this.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
古时候，拉菲尼会用这样的小袋子装妖精粉尘，比如飞行粉尘、缩小粉尘。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
They usually enjoy extravagant designs, but this 'fairy dust pouch' is something that they always carry around, and it is made simply without extravagant ornaments, keeping in line with tradition.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
它们平时喜欢华丽的设计，但这种“妖精粉尘袋”是随身携带的必需品，为了遵循传统，样式一向简单朴素。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
I'm not sure what it'll be like nowadays, but if this is the 'fairy dust pouch,' the owner should be anxious to find it.
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
我不清楚如今的情况，不过如果这真是“妖精粉尘袋”，它的主人一定很着急想找回来。

scripts.text:
[Theore]
We can't give it back for free though. In exchange for some information - that's a fair deal!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
不过也不能白白还给它们。拿情报来交换...这很公平吧！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
And perhaps they won't be too upset if we look inside the pouch!
Wooow!!
I always believed when I was little that a fairy would come and sprinkle me with flying dust to make me fly!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
也许我们看看袋子里装了什么，它们也不会太介意！
哇！！
我小时候一直相信会有妖精来给我撒上飞行粉尘，让我飞起来！！！

scripts.text:
- Before I can stop him, -
- he opened the small pouch. -
scripts.translation:
- 我还没来得及阻止他， -
- 他就打开了那个小袋子。 -

scripts.text:
[Theore]
.......

[Theore]
Oh...
Berries......and leaves?
.......
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
哦...
是浆果...还有叶子？
...

scripts.text:
[Theore]
......What about the flying dust?
Noooo!
My poor innocent imagination!!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
...飞行粉尘呢？
不啊！！！
我那可怜又天真的幻想！！！

scripts.text: - He is in no state for conversations. You should take the pouch to Splendide and look for its owner. -
scripts.translation: - 他现在没法交谈。你应该把这个小袋子带去辉煌领域，找找它的主人。 -

scripts.text: - He is in no state for conversations. You should take the pouch to Splendide and look for its owner. -
scripts.translation: - 他现在没法交谈。你应该把这个小袋子带去辉煌领域，找找它的主人。 -

scripts.text: - He appears to be busy. You should finish the task at hand and come back. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎正忙着。先完成手头的事，再回来找他吧。 -

scripts.text:
[Theore]
At last, you're back!!!!
How did the investigation go?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
你总算回来了！！！
调查得怎么样？！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Wow!!!
Incredible!!!!!!
Unbelievable!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
哇！！！
太惊人了！！！
简直难以置信！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
The best!!!!
This is surely enough to write an excellent report on!!
All thanks to you, Warrior!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
太棒了！！！
这些情报肯定够我写出一份精彩的报告！！
全靠你了，勇士！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
I'll never, EVER forget what you've done for me!
No!!
My grandchildren's grandchildren will remember!!!!
*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
我永远、永远不会忘记你为我做的一切！
不！
就连我的子子孙孙都会记住！！！！
*呜咽*

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Then I'm off to put the finishing touches on the report!!!!!!!
Oh yeah!!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
那我这就去给报告收个尾！！！
哦耶！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
I'll write the report with lightning speed!!!!!!!
Oh yeah!!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
我马上就能飞快地写完报告！！！
哦耶！！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
Aaaarrrggghh!!!
Darn it!!!!
I'm finished!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
啊啊啊啊！！
可恶！！
我完蛋了！！

scripts.text:
[Theore]
How am I supposed to submit a report that's so bad!!! A 5-year-old could do better!!!
Noooo!!!
scripts.translation:
[西奥雷]
这么糟糕的报告，我怎么交得出去！！！五岁小孩写得都比我好！！！
不啊！！！

scripts.text: - It's just an ordinary bush. -
scripts.translation: - 那只是一丛普通的灌木。 -

scripts.text:
[Unarmed Laphine]
Aaaarrrrrggggghhhhh!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[手无寸铁的拉菲尼]
啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！

scripts.text:
- You try to talk to the Laphine, -
- who is looking around the bushes, -
- but it flew away -
- while yelling fearfully. -
scripts.translation:
- 你试着和那只正在灌木丛间张望的拉菲尼交谈， -
- 可它惊恐地大叫一声， -
- 转眼就飞走了。 -

scripts.text:
- What was the fairy doing? -
- You decide to look around. -
scripts.translation:
- 刚才那只妖精在做什么？ -
- 你决定四处找找。 -

scripts.text:
- Hang on there !! -
 - You are carrying too many kinds of items - 
 - to receive any more items. - 
 - Please lighten your load - 
 - and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你携带的物品种类太多， -
- 无法再领取物品。 -
- 请清出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
- Hang on there !! -
 - You are carrying too much weight - 
 - Please lighten your load - 
 - and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你的负重太高了。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
- Jumble Fumble -
- Rustle Bustle -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找摸索 -
- 窸窸窣窣 -

scripts.text: - You've found a Small pouch. -
scripts.translation: - 你发现了一个小袋子。 -

scripts.text: - You didn't find anything. -
scripts.translation: - 你什么也没找到。 -

scripts.text:
[Tired-looking Fairy]
VeOsaRiveh No ModAsh
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的妖精]
VeOsaRiveh No ModAsh

scripts.text:
- You can't understand the fairy's words. -
- You need something to help you interpret them. -
scripts.translation:
- 你听不懂妖精的话。 -
- 需要找个东西帮你翻译。 -

scripts.text:
[Tired-looking Fairy]
I'm tired, don't talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的妖精]
我累了，别来烦我。

[Tired-looking Fairy]
I'm tired, don't talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[疲惫的妖精]
我累了，别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Tired-looking Fairy]
I'm tired, don't talk to me.

scripts.translation:

谢谢您！！！！！
我找了好久好久！

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
That's a difficult questionn!
But you've returned my pouch, so I'll have to answerr......
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
这问题可难倒我了！
不过你帮我找回了袋子，我就告诉你吧...

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Promise me you won't tell anyonee!
If you can promise, please talk to me againn.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
答应我，绝对不能告诉别人哦！
答应了的话，再来找我聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Hmm I don't know who, but must be a slobb to be dropping his pouch like soo.
Huh? Mine??
No, mine is right here safelyy?
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
嗯...不知道是谁丢的，不过把袋子弄丢的人肯定很邋遢。
咦？我的？
不可能，我的袋子好好地在这儿呢。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
It's a precious object so I hope you'll find the owner itt.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
这可是很重要的东西，希望你能找到它的主人。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
You can't say this to anybody okayy~?
Recently,
the supplies from our the mainland have been cutt!
Or rather, the supply route is being blocked and we can't get our suppliess?
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
这件事可不能告诉别人哦~
最近，大陆送来的补给断了！
应该说，是补给路线被堵住了，我们收不到物资。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
We need to find enough food before we run out of stored goods, that's why we've been rummaging the bushess.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
库存耗尽之前，我们得找到足够的食物，所以才一直在灌木丛里翻找。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
But this cursed frozen land has no good foods.
We're barely keeping it green using magic, but it takes too much power to make fruit.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
可是这片被诅咒的冻土上，根本找不到好吃的东西。
我们勉强靠魔法让这里保持绿意，但用魔法造出果实要耗费太多力量。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
The energy spent in making food is probably twice as much as the energy gained from eatingg.
Those higher up don't want to admit it, but it's going to become a serious problem soonn.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
制造食物消耗的能量，大概是吃下去所能补充能量的两倍。
上头的人不愿承认，但这很快就会变成大问题。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
We can't leave the battleground because we're in war, so we can't go checkk.
I am curiousss.......
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
因为还在打仗，我们不能离开战场去查看。
真让人在意...

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Not just me, but many Laphines are worriedd.
Well that's the situation, so if you meet a Laphine in the bushes please don't talk to himm.
It's embarrassingg!!!
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
不只我一个，很多拉菲尼都很担心。
总之，如果你在灌木丛里遇到拉菲尼，千万别跟它说话。
太丢脸了！！！

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Oh, and you must never ever tell anyone about what happened todayy!
Unless that person wanted to help uss... spreading the word won't do Splendide any goood.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
还有，今天的事绝对不能告诉别人！
除非对方愿意帮助我们，否则把消息传出去对辉煌领域没有好处。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Eh?
You stilll want to talk?
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
咦？
你还想聊什么？

scripts.text: Supply route from the mainland?
scripts.translation: 大陆来的补给路线？

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Well if you hear that you'll have to helpp!
Still want to knoww?!
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
你都听到这份上了，恐怕就得帮忙了！
还想继续听吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 想。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不想。

It's not a special road or anythingg.
Just an old roadd.
Some say it connects different continents. It also connects the Splendide Basecamp and Alfheim through the backk.
scripts.translation:

那不是什么特别的道路，只是一条旧路。
有人说它能通往不同的大陆。它还从后方连接着辉煌领域营地和阿尔夫海姆。

如果你要去那边，麻烦顺路看看那里的情况。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
A crevicee?
That's why we couldn't contact the mainland.
Urggg.......
It would be good to know what's going on up theree.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
一道裂缝？
难怪我们联系不上大陆。
唉...
真想知道那边到底发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
If you happen to go through Bifrost, please figure out what's going onn.
In the middle of Bifrost is a small village called 'Mora.' All the supplies from the mainland come through that villagee.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
如果你经过彩虹桥，麻烦查明那边发生了什么。
彩虹桥中央有个叫“穆拉”的小村庄，大陆送来的补给都要经过那里。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
If you go to the warehouse in Mora Village, the manager will tell you moree.
Also, on the way back, will you check to see that my friend Rondo is in Mora Villagee?
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
你去穆拉村的仓库问问管理员，他会告诉你更多。
另外，回来时能帮我看看朋友隆多在不在穆拉村吗？

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
He always used to visit Splendide around this time, but the situation is no good now. I'll have to tell him to come another time.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
他以前总在这个时候来辉煌领域，可现在情况不太好。我得告诉他改天再来。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Heee!
You really went through the fog of the Maze of the Hazy Forest?
Wow!!!
That's very impressivee.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
哎！
你真的穿过了迷雾森林迷宫的浓雾？
哇！！！
太厉害了。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Thank you soooo much.
I hope we'll be able to go through Bifrost againn.
I want to meet Rondo and talk to him againn.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
真是太感谢你了。
希望我们还能再次走过彩虹桥。
我想再见见隆多，和他聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
Oh, And Daphrer is in northwest Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
对了，达弗雷尔在辉煌领域西北边。

scripts.text:
[Kusmi]
This place is always coldd.
So different from my heavenly hometownn.
scripts.translation:
[库斯米]
这里总是冷飕飕的。
和我那美丽的故乡完全不一样。

Who are you!
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
你是谁！

scripts.text: Show the pouch.
scripts.translation: 把小袋子给他看。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Hmm? What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
嗯？你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Ahh!!
My pouch!!!!!
I've been looking for it all over the place.
Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
啊！！
我的袋子！！！！！
我找遍了所有地方。
谢谢你！

scripts.text: Ask about the rumor.
scripts.translation: 打听传闻。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Hrm!!
What a penetrating question!
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
哼！！
问得真够尖锐的！

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
If you really want to hear the answer, talk to me again.
I need time to think.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
你真想知道答案的话，就再来找我。
我得先想一想。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
What is that dirty pouch!
It is definitely not mine.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
这脏兮兮的袋子是什么？
肯定不是我的。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
But I hope you find its rightful owner.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
不过，希望你能找到真正的主人。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
You are not to tell anyone what I'm about to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
我接下来要说的话，你绝不能告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Recently, there's a big problem in Splendide.
There is no communication with the mainland.
Not just communication, but supplies have been cut off also. People act indifferent but actually there is deep panic.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
辉煌领域最近出了大问题。
我们和大陆失去了联系。
不只是通讯中断，补给也断了。大家表面上装作若无其事，心里其实慌得很。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
This frozen land is no use for collecting food, but to farm it would be too much work.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
这片冻土不适合采集食物，可要耕种又得花上很大力气。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
In fact, just maintaining the green is costing an incredible amount of magic power.
No word has come from higher up, but from the rumors it's not an easily fixable problem.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
事实上，光是让这里维持绿意，就要耗费惊人的魔力。
上面没有传来消息，但听传闻说，这问题没那么容易解决。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
And because there is no easy fix, everybody is worried sick.
By military law, our soldiers cannot leave the battlefield during war, so it's impossible to get more information.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
问题迟迟解决不了，大家都忧心忡忡。
按照军法，战时士兵不能离开战场，所以我们也无法打听更多消息。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Therefore, if you happen to run into a Laphine, please don't mention any of this.
Everybody is trying as hard as they can, but we are still a proud race.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
所以，如果你遇到拉菲尼，请别提起这些事。
大家都在尽力支撑，但我们毕竟是个骄傲的种族。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
And as I said before, what I told you is a secret and you must not tell anyone.
We do need help, but we are cornered and we don't want others to know.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
还有，我刚才告诉你的都是秘密，绝不能泄露。
我们确实需要帮助，可如今已被逼入绝境，不想让外人知道。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
You have further business with me?
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
你还有别的事找我吗？

scripts.text: Supply route from the mainland?
scripts.translation: 大陆来的补给路线？

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Hmm... if you hear that, you might just have to help us out?
Do you still want to know?
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
嗯...要是我告诉你，你恐怕就得帮忙了。
还想继续听吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 想。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不想。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
The supply route comes through Bifrost, and you can get to it from the back of the Splendide Basecamp.
That is why we set up the basecamp here.
The origin of the route is unclear, but it has been known for a long time to be a bridge that connects continents.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
补给路线经过彩虹桥，从辉煌领域营地后方就能抵达。
这也是我们把营地设在这里的原因。
这条路线的源头不明，但很久以前就有人说，它是一座连接各个大陆的桥。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
If you happen to venture there, please ask a guard what things are like there.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
如果你要去那边，能帮忙问问守卫那里的情况吗？

scripts.text:

Thank you for getting the pouch back to me.
Fairy dust? I don't carry around such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
谢谢你把袋子还给我。
妖精粉尘？我可没带那种东西。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
The supply route comes through Bifrost, and you can get to it from the back of the Splendide Basecamp.
That is why we set up the basecamp here.
The origin of the route is unclear, but it has been known for a long time to be a bridge that connects continents.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
补给路线经过彩虹桥，从辉煌领域营地后方就能抵达。
这也是我们把营地设在这里的原因。
这条路线的源头不明，但很久以前就有人说，它是一座连接各个大陆的桥。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
If you happen to venture there, please ask a guard what things are like there.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
如果你要去那边，能帮忙问问守卫那里的情况吗？

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
A crevice?
So that was why we couldn't reach the mainland.
It would be good to know what's going on up there.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
一道裂缝？
原来这就是我们联系不上大陆的原因。
真想知道那边到底发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Hmm...
I can't leave here, but you would be able to, no?
The supplies from the mainland come through 'Mora' Village, which is located in the middle of Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
嗯...
我不能离开这里，不过你可以去吧？
大陆的补给要经过彩虹桥中央的“穆拉”村庄。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
If you speak to the Warehouse Manager of Mora Village, you'd be able to get more information.
If you're willing, will you go to Bifrost's 'Mora' Village and meet the Warehouse Manager?
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
去穆拉村找仓库管理员，应该能打听到更多消息。
你愿意去彩虹桥上的“穆拉”村，见见仓库管理员吗？

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
And if it's not too much trouble, you could drop by my friend Lilitia's also...
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
还有，不麻烦的话，也请顺路去看看我的朋友莉莉缇娅...

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
And if it's not too much trouble, you could drop by my friend Lilitia's also...
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
还有，不麻烦的话，也请顺路去看看我的朋友莉莉缇娅...

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Wow!!!
So you went through the Maze of the Hazy Forest and returned from Mora Village.
I made the right decision by asking you!
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
哇！！！
你真的穿过了迷雾森林迷宫，还从穆拉村回来了。
我果然没看错人！

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Thank you.
I hope this gets resolved soon...
I don't want to further upset Lilitia...
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
谢谢你。
希望事情能尽快解决...
我不想让莉莉缇娅更难过...

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Oh, And Daphrer is in northwest Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
对了，达弗雷尔在辉煌领域西北边。

scripts.text:
[Theodore]
Sometimes, I sense a painful beauty in this frozen earth, quite different from the beauty of my hometown.
But this is a difficult environment for us to live in, certainly.
scripts.translation:
[西奥多]
有时我会在这片冰封大地上感受到一种凄美，和故乡的风景截然不同。
不过这里的环境确实不适合我们生活。

ModAnduLo
Mod
DorDuMe U NohLarsFulo Mu Fus
scripts.translation:

ModAnduLo
Mod

scripts.text:
- You can't understand the fairy's words. -
- You need something to help you interpret them. -
scripts.translation:
- 你听不懂妖精的话。 -
- 需要找个东西帮你翻译。 -

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
What can I do for you, sir?
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
先生，有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Show the pouch.
scripts.translation: 把小袋子给他看。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Huh? Do you see something?
I don't see anything...
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
嗯？你看到什么了吗？
我什么也没看见...

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Good heavens...!
I think this is mine!
Thank you.
I've been worried since I lost it, you lifted a burden off of my mind.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
天哪...！
这好像是我的袋子！
谢谢你。
丢了以后我一直放心不下，这下总算松了口气。

scripts.text: Ask about the rumor.
scripts.translation: 打听传闻。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
That's not easy for me to answer...
I do appreciate you finding my pouch.... Hmm...
Please give me some time to think..
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
这问题我不太好回答...
你帮我找回袋子，我很感激...嗯...
请给我一点时间想想。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Oh dear. It's not mine.
But to carelessly drop such an important object!
I don't know who it is, but that Laphine needs a lesson!
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
哎呀，这不是我的袋子。
这么重要的东西怎么能随手弄丢！
不知道是哪只拉菲尼丢的，真该好好教训它一顿！

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
What I'm about to tell you is top secret!
We don't even talk about it amongst ourselves!
How would we say that the supply from the mainland's been cut off like that!
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
我要告诉你的可是绝密！
我们自己人之间都不敢提！
怎么能说大陆的补给被切断了呢！

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Ugh?!
Oh boy... I've done it....
It's really a top secret!!
Don't tell anybody!
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
啊？！
糟了...我说漏嘴了...
这可是绝密情报！！
千万别告诉别人！

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Well since I spilled the beans already... oh well, too late.
So it's been a while since we received supplies from the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
既然都说漏嘴了...唉，算了。
总之，我们已经有一阵子没收到大陆的补给了。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
We're not starving, but we're receiving less and less food.
I was hungry so I went to go pick fruit, but in this cold climate there are no fruit trees.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
我们还不至于挨饿，可食物越来越少。
我饿了，就想去摘点果子，可这么冷的地方根本没有果树。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
And the people higher up only tell us to wait... I'm so tired of waiting!
But the instant I leave this place, I'll end up going to prison....
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
上面的人只让我们等...我受够了！
可我只要一离开这里，就会被关进牢里...

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
So I'm stuck here, and I'll be stuck here, suffering from hunger.... *sob*
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
所以我只能困在这里，饿着肚子...呜...

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
I'd eat the bark off of that tree if I could.
If only somebody could help. *sob*
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
要是可以，我连那棵树的树皮都想啃下来。
要是有人肯帮帮忙就好了...呜...

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
What?
What do you want... I'm hungry, don't have energy to talk...
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
什么事？你想做什么...我饿得连说话的力气都没有...

scripts.text: Supply route from the mainland?
scripts.translation: 大陆来的补给路线？

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Are you going to help me if I tell you?
If not, I won't tell.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
我告诉你之后，你会帮忙吗？
不帮的话，我就不说。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 会。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不会。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
A giant road leads away from the back of Splendide.
I don't know if it's related to legends and what not, but I've heard that the road's been there forever.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
有条大路从辉煌领域后方延伸出去。
我不知道它是不是和什么传说有关，只听说那条路自古以来就在那里。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Oh! The guard there might know something.
If you're headed that way, please go find out what's up.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
哦，那边的守卫说不定知道些什么。
你要是往那边去，帮忙打听一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Thank you for finding the pouch.
Ugh... I'm starving... I suppose I'll have to eat these bitter berries...
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
谢谢你帮我找回袋子。
唉...饿死我了...看来只能吃这些苦涩的浆果了...

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
A giant road leads away from the back of Splendide.
I don't know if it's related to legends and what not, but I've heard that the road's been there forever.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[波雄]
哦，那边的守卫说不定知道些什么。
你要是往那边去，帮忙打听一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Crevice?!?
Hmm I have heard that crevices are creeping up here and there, but it even infiltrated Bifrost....
It appears to be more serious than I had imagined.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
裂缝？！
嗯，我听说裂缝四处蔓延，没想到连彩虹桥也被波及了...
看来事情比我想象的严重得多。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
If you can, would you go to 'Mora' Village in Bifrost and figure out what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
方便的话，能不能去彩虹桥上的“穆拉”村调查一下？

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
The supplies from the mainland come through the Village. If you go speak to the Warehouse Manager, he'll be able to tell you something.
Also, please pay a visit to my friend Humming.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
大陆的补给都要经过那个村子。你去问问仓库管理员，他应该知道些什么。
还有，麻烦你去看看我的朋友哼唱声。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
He's such a flighty guy, might have already left, but we were supposed to meet up in Mora Village.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
他这个人不太安分，可能早就走了，不过我们约好在穆拉村碰面。

大陆的补给都要经过那个村子。你去问问仓库管理员，他应该知道些什么。

He's such a flighty guy, might have already left, but we were supposed to meet up in Mora Village.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
他这个人不太安分，可能早就走了，不过我们约好在穆拉村碰面。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Please pay a visit to my friend Humming.
He's such a flighty guy, might have already left, but we were supposed to meet up in Mora Village.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
请去看看我的朋友哼唱声。
他这个人不太安分，可能早就走了，不过我们约好在穆拉村碰面。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
I had my doubts...But you really did cross the legendary Maze of the Hazy Forest...
I'm very impressed.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
我本来还有点怀疑...没想到你真穿越了传说中的迷雾森林迷宫...
真令人佩服。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
I really appreciate your help.
I hope this gets resolved soon.
What I'm really afraid of... is hunger. More than war.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
真是太感谢你了。
希望事情能尽快解决。
比起战争，我更害怕...挨饿。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Oh, And Daphrer is in northwest Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
对了，达弗雷尔在辉煌领域西北边。

scripts.text:
[Pauchon]
Ah... I'm hungry.
When I get back to the mainland I'm going to stuff my belly until it bursts.
scripts.translation:
[波雄]
啊...我好饿。
等我回到大陆，一定要大吃一顿，吃到肚子撑破为止。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
This is Bifrost, which leads to Alfheim.
Please note that entry is forbidden due to a crevice caused by an unidentified source.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
这里是彩虹桥，通往阿尔夫海姆。
由于不明原因出现了裂缝，目前禁止通行。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
The other way leads to the Maze of the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
另一条路通往迷雾森林迷宫。

scripts.text:
[Laphine Soldier]
You can get to Alfheim by making it through the Maze of the Hazy Forest. However, nobody has ever come back from the Maze of the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼士兵]
穿过迷雾森林迷宫就能抵达阿尔夫海姆。不过，还没有人从迷宫里回来过。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
No, sir!
You cannot enter at will.
This is a warehouse. If you need something, please ask the staff outside.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员]
不行，先生！
您不能随意进入。
这里是仓库，需要什么请去外面找工作人员。

scripts.text: Supplies for Laphine?
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼的补给品？

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
Ah!
You're from Splendide?
Let's see...
All the supplies from over there to there are destined for Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员]
啊！
您是从辉煌领域来的？
我看看...
那边运来的这些补给，都是要送去辉煌领域的。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
We are quite worried too because the crevice in Bifrost has made it impossible to deliver these goods.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员]
我们也很担心。彩虹桥出现裂缝后，这些货物就没法送出去了。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
And the travelers who were heading down are also stuck here. The increasing number of customers is both a blessing and a curse..
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员]
原本要离开这里的旅人也都被困住了。客人越来越多，真是有喜有忧...

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
If you plan to go back to Splendide, pay a visit to Jones at the Inn.
He has something that needs to be urgently delivered to the army of Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员]
如果您打算回辉煌领域，请去旅馆找琼斯。
他有一件急需送给辉煌领域军队的东西。

scripts.text:
[Warehouse Manager]
If you plan to go back to Splendide, pay a visit to Jones at the Inn.
He has something that needs to be urgently delivered to the army of Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员]
如果您打算回辉煌领域，请去旅馆找琼斯。
他有一件急需送给辉煌领域军队的东西。

scripts.text:

We are quite worried too because the crevice in Bifrost has made it impossible to deliver these goods.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

And the travelers who were heading down are also stuck here. The increasing number of customers is both a blessing and a curse...
scripts.translation:
[仓库管理员]
原本要离开这里的旅人也都被困住了。客人越来越多，真是有喜有忧...

scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Mora is such a mysterious place.
You can understand any language.
scripts.translation:
[隆多]
穆拉真是个神秘的地方。
在这里，什么语言都能听懂。

scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Of course, when we leave this area I won't be able to understand what you say, but I'll be able to remember the conversations we had. And I'll look forward to the day we meet again, here.
scripts.translation:
[隆多]
当然，一离开这里，我就听不懂你说的话了。不过我们聊过什么，我还是会记得。我期待着有一天能在这里与你重逢。

scripts.text:
[Rondo]
Please tell Kusmi
that if he wants to meet, we can meet any time. There is nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[隆多]
请告诉库斯米，想见我的话随时都可以，不必担心。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
Boo!!!
He broke his promise again!!!
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
哇！！！
他又一次失约了！！！

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
He said he'd be here this time for sure!!!
That place is too cold for me to visit!!!!!
My precious leaves will wither there.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
他说这次一定会来的！！！
那地方冷得要命，我才不去呢！！！
我珍贵的叶子会在那里枯萎的。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
What? Theodore sent you?
Please tell him that I'm so mad!!
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
什么？西奥多派你来的？
告诉他，我可气坏了！！

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
I really hate the cold.
That's why Mora is a lovely place to live.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
我最讨厌冷了。
所以穆拉是个宜居的好地方。

scripts.text:
[Lilitia]
The leaves are always fresh here. And, the stress about languages just disappears.
scripts.translation:
[莉莉缇娅]
这里的叶子总是鲜嫩的，而且再也不用为语言不通烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
Oh!
You're here because Pauchon sent you?
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
哦！
是波雄派你来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Humming]
It must've been hard for you to get here. I'm impressed.
The Maze of the Hazy Forest~ It fuels my adventurous spirit!
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
你能到这里一定费了不少劲，真令人佩服。
迷雾森林迷宫~真能激起我的冒险热情！

scripts.text:
[Humming]
If you reach Splendide before me, please tell Pauchon
that I'm going through the Maze of the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
如果你比我先到辉煌领域，麻烦告诉波雄，
我正在穿越迷雾森林迷宫。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
I heard that a crevice crept in between Jotunheim and Midgard, so I wanted to check it out. But I got stuck here.
I was looking forward to seeing a new place.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
我听说约顿海姆和米德加尔特之间出现了裂缝，就想去看看，结果被困在这里了。
我本来很期待能去新的地方看看。

scripts.text:
[Humming]
Are you from Midgard?
What is it like there?
I've always wanted to see a creature called Poring.
scripts.translation:
[哼唱声]
你来自米德加尔特吗？
那里是什么样子？
我一直很想看看一种叫波利的生物。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Oh.... Darn.......
I can't go down, and I can't go back. My credibility that I've worked so hard on is just crumbling into dust.
scripts.translation:
[琼斯]
唉...该死...
我进退两难。辛辛苦苦建立的信誉，就要毁于一旦了。

scripts.text:
[Jones]
Ah, are you the traveler who came through the Maze of the Hazy Forest from Splendide?

好吧，那我也没办法。
今天只好让别人去办。
不过从明天开始就得你来做了，知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
... Huh? I think I've seen you somewhere...
..........Oh!
{0}...?!
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...咦？我好像在哪儿见过你...
...哦！
{0}...？！
你怎么会在这里？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You say you've forgotten what to do?
You're not supposed to be here.
You're supposed to be at the crevice to the south of Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你说你忘了要做什么？
你不该待在这里。
你应该去迪卡特斯南边的裂缝。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Whoa.
What was Ahat thinking when he sent such an idiot to me?
Now, get a move on and do your job.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
哇。
阿哈特怎么会派这种笨蛋来找我？
快去干活，别磨蹭。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Why isn't this fellow showing up?
Should be here by now...
Lost the way back perhaps...?
....? Eh? Who, who are you? How long have you been standing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...那家伙怎么还没来？
早该到了...
该不会找不到回来的路吧...?
...咦？你、你是谁？在这里站多久了？

scripts.text: A cat?!
scripts.translation: 一只猫？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Who... who's a cat?!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
谁...谁是猫？！
快滚！

scripts.text:
..........?
You sense someone moving around.
There must be someone down there.
scripts.translation:
...？
你感觉到有人在下面活动。
下面一定有人。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
...Eh?
What a surprise. What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...咦？
真意外，你怎么在这里？

scripts.text: And what are YOU doing here?
scripts.translation: 那你怎么会在这里？

scripts.text: Those ears...?
scripts.translation: 那对耳朵...？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
Out for a walk?
I came out with Ahat, but he went back in to take care of an urgent matter.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
出来散散步？
我和阿哈特一起出来的，不过他回去处理急事了。

scripts.text: Wha... What a pretty tree.
scripts.translation: 哇...那棵树真漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
This tree... it's white, transparent, and shiny.
It's a Sapha's body.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
这棵树...白色、透明，还闪闪发亮。
这是萨法的身体。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
You know Saphas slowly turn to stone throughout their lives.
So when they die, they turn to stony trees.
This forest is... their cemetery, so to speak.
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你知道萨法一生中会逐渐石化吧？
所以死后就会变成石树。
这片森林...可以说是它们的墓地。

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
....... Look closely, and you can make out his arms and legs.
Interesting, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
...仔细看，还能看出它的手臂和腿。
很有意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
... .. ...

[Cheshire]
Oh, this is so annoying.
I'm off!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
唉，真烦。
我走了！

scripts.text: - Cheshire stormed off... -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡气冲冲地走了... -

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What? The ears?
Well, it's no wonder because I'm a beastman.
... Why... Why are you staring me like that?
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
什么？说我的耳朵？
我可是兽人，有耳朵很正常。
...你、你干吗一直盯着我？

scripts.text: Are you responsible for the report?!
scripts.translation: 是你负责这份报告吗？！

scripts.text:
[Cheshire]
What are you talking about?
I don't know such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[柴郡]
你在说什么？
我可不知道这回事！

scripts.text: - Cheshire ran away... -
scripts.translation: - 柴郡逃走了... -

scripts.text:
A boy dressed in unusual clothing is standing, with a fierce look in his eyes.
You guess you'd better leave him alone.
scripts.translation:
一个穿着奇装异服的男孩站在那里，眼神凶狠。
你觉得还是别去招惹他为妙。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
You are very delicate.
It's true that I need help,
but I don't think you can help.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你真是个多愁善感的人。
我确实需要帮忙，
可我不觉得你能帮得上。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I hear you passed through the Hazy Forest.
Did you...
Did you happen to see
Lope, my fiance, there?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
听说你去过迷雾森林。
你...
有没有在那里见过
我的未婚夫洛佩？

scripts.text: Yes, I did.
scripts.translation: 见过。

scripts.text: No, I didn't.
scripts.translation: 没有。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Are you sure? Where did you see him?
Take me there, quick!
...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你确定吗？在哪里见到他的？
快带我过去！
...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
What?
You're kidding...?
How could you?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
什么？
你在开玩笑吧...？
怎么会这样？

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Please find my Lope.
I came here to the Village of Mora
after asking all around,
but there is nothing more I can do.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
求你帮我找到洛佩。
我到处打听后才来到穆拉村，
可现在已经无计可施了。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
My heart aches at the thought of Lope...
He will be desperately looking for me...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
一想到洛佩，我就心如刀割...
他一定也在拼命找我...

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙！

scripts.text: I'll help you!
scripts.translation: 我来帮你！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
How heartless!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你真无情！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I heard that he had gone into the Hazy Forest,
while guiding tourists around the village.
One of the tourists who went with Lope
must still be at the inn.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
听说洛佩带游客在村子附近游览时，走进了迷雾森林。
和他同行的一名游客应该还住在旅馆。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
He wouldn't see me and locked himself in the room.
But he might be willing to see you, because you've been to the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
他不肯见我，把自己锁在房间里。
不过你去过迷雾森林，他也许愿意和你谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
The tourist is at the inn,
not in front of me!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
那个游客在旅馆里，
又不在我面前！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
So you've seen Pitt!
I knew he would be willing to see you.
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
你见到皮特了？
我就知道他愿意见你。
他说了什么？

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
...No way....!
That is utter nonsense.
To blame Lope for it!
I found this piece of paper
near the Hazy Forest.
I'm sure it's Lope's.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
...怎么可能...！
这简直是胡说八道。
竟然把过错推到洛佩身上！
我在迷雾森林附近捡到这张纸片。
我敢肯定是洛佩的。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
If you find the rest of ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000,
you'll be able to find out
where he is.
I'm counting on you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
如果能找到剩下的^0000FF洛佩的线索^000000，
就能查出他在哪里。
拜托你了，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
If you come across a ^0000FFLope's Clue^000000, please show it to Pitt.
I hope he will tell the truth soon.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
如果你找到^0000FF洛佩的线索^000000，请拿给皮特看看。
希望他能尽快说出实情。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I don't understand it.
I'm now suspicious of his motives.
Why is he trying so hard to accuse Lope?
Wait... those clues...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我不明白。
我开始怀疑他的动机了。
他为什么拼命指责洛佩？
等等...那些线索...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Those seem to be more than simple notes.
Can I have a look at them?
...
These fit together like a puzzle.
... Oh!... This is...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
这些不像普通的笔记。
能让我看看吗？
...
它们能像拼图一样拼起来。
...哦！...这是...

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...We've been wandering around the Forest for days.
...So we're not protecting the tourists,
I got sick from deadly poison, and became a burden to everyone.
How pathetic...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...我们在森林里徘徊了好几天。
...我没有保护好游客，
还中了致命的毒，成了大家的累赘。
我真没用...

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
No wonder I was kicked out of
the Splendide Expedition.
...But I managed to protect at least one tourist.
He will deliver this letter and the ring to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
难怪我会被辉煌领域探险队开除。
...不过至少我保护了一名游客。
他会把这封信和戒指交给你。

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...I wanted to propose to you
as a proud member of the Expedition.
I'm sorry, Euridi.
See you soon.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...我原本想以探险队成员的身份，堂堂正正地向你求婚。
对不起，尤里迪。
再见。

scripts.text:
Having read the letter,
Euridi is standing staring blankly like someone who wasn't all there.
Let's go show the letter to Pitt.
scripts.translation:
读完信后，尤里迪呆呆地站在那里，仿佛失了魂。
把信拿给皮特看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
No, Lope must be safe.
He will come back no matter what...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
不，洛佩一定平安无事。
无论如何...他都会回来的...

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
......

You hear a song coming from the girl who is hanging her head low.
Her friend seems to have something to say.
scripts.translation:
你听见那个垂着头的女孩轻声唱着歌。
她的朋友似乎有话想说。

scripts.text:
You hear a quiet singing voice.
You can't make the words out.
scripts.translation:
你听见一阵低低的歌声。
听不清她在唱什么。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Have you found Lope?
Is he safe?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
找到洛佩了吗？
他还好吗？

scripts.text: Tell her you can't possibly find him.
scripts.translation: 告诉她你不可能找到他。

scripts.text: Tell her he is dead.
scripts.translation: 告诉她他已经死了。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I'll go look for him myself.
Hopefully... it's not too late, yet.
Let me go, there's no time to lose!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我要自己去找他。
希望...还不算太迟。
放开我，不能再浪费时间了！

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
I don't believe it.
He told me he would come back soon...
He told me to hang on.
It can't be... It just can't be...
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
我不相信。
他说过很快就会回来...
他说让我等着他。
不可能...这绝不可能...

scripts.text:
You hand her Lope's Ring, which Pitt gave you.
With the ring in her hand, Euridi bursts into tears.
She starts to sing in a strained voice, still crying.
scripts.translation:
你把皮特交给你的洛佩之戒递给她。
尤里迪握着戒指，顿时失声痛哭。
她一边哭，一边用沙哑的声音唱起歌来。

scripts.text:
You stand frozen.
You hear a quiet singing voice.
scripts.translation:
你愣在原地。
耳边传来一阵低低的歌声。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Please stop Euridi.
She is desperate to find her missing fiance.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
快劝劝尤里迪。
她一心想找到失踪的未婚夫。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Pitt is definitely suspicious.
I think he is avoiding Euridi...
He must be hiding something.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
皮特肯定有问题。
我觉得他一直在躲尤里迪...
他一定隐瞒了什么。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
To tell the truth, I don't think
that Lope is alive.
I'm just worried about Euridi.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
说实话，我觉得洛佩恐怕已经不在人世了。
我只是担心尤里迪。

scripts.text:
[Euridi]
Aaarrrggghhh!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪]
啊啊啊啊！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
...
To tell the truth, I really believe
that Lope is alive.
...
*sigh*
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
...
老实说，我真的相信洛佩还活着。
...
*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
How's Pitt doing?
I think I should go visit him
and make him feel worse!
He's so disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
皮特怎么样了？
我得去找他，
让他更难受些！
他真让人恶心！

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Go to Pitt, quick.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
快去找皮特。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Euridi is singing a song of healing
to protect her weakened body and mind.
At this rate, something's going to happen to her too.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
尤里迪正在唱治愈之歌，
好让虚弱的身心撑下去。
再这样下去，她也会出事的。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Oh, I remember a traveler telling me
that he had seen a suspicious man
near the entrance to the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
哦，我想起来，有个旅人跟我说，
他在迷雾森林入口附近
见到一个可疑的男人。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
The traveler says he looked creepy standing there staring blankly,
but he couldn't see clearly
because of the thick fog.
I think it's worth investigating.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
旅人说那人站着发呆，看起来很诡异，
但雾太浓，
看不清他的样子。
我觉得值得去查查。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
I hear that a suspicious man was seen
near the entrance to the Hazy Forest.
The traveler says he looked creepy standing there staring blankly,
but he couldn't see clearly
because of the thick fog.
I think it's worth investigating.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
听说迷雾森林入口附近
出现过一个可疑的男人。
旅人说那人站着发呆，看起来很诡异，
但雾太浓，
看不清他的样子。
我觉得值得去查查。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Your face is dark.
Bad news?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
你脸色不太好。
有坏消息吗？

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
There is a Laphine saying that
desperation invites disaster.
Maybe we're responsible
for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
拉菲尼有句谚语：
绝望会招来灾祸。
也许我们该为
发生的事负责。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
You have too many things with you.
Can you throw out some of them?
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
你带的东西太多了。
能扔掉一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Lope will be able to rest in peace now.
Thank you. I won't forget what you've done for me.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
洛佩现在可以安息了。
谢谢你，我不会忘记你为我做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Euridi's Friend]
Thank you. I won't forget your help.
scripts.translation:
[尤里迪的朋友]
谢谢你，我不会忘记你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So you're quite good,
since you passed through the Hazy Forest alive.
I'm completely messed up, you see,
so I can't afford to listen to the tales of your exploits.
Now leave.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
能活着穿过迷雾森林，看来你挺有本事。
我自己都焦头烂额了，没空听你吹嘘冒险经历。
现在离开。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
You have a knack for pestering people, don't you?
Euridi sent you, eh?
The Laphine couple is
anxious to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你倒挺会缠人的，是吧？
尤里迪派你来的？
那对拉菲尼夫妇
恨不得杀了我。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
Go and tell her!
That the stupid guide
pushed us reluctant tourists into the forest,
and ran off to save his own skin!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
去告诉她！
那个蠢向导
把不情愿的游客推进森林，
自己却溜了，只顾逃命！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So you're sorry that it's me, not him, that's here?
He will be alive somewhere,
so go and try to find him! Just stop bothering me!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
所以你是嫌在这儿的是我，而不是他？
他肯定还活在某个地方，
你自己去找啊！别再烦我了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is all because of
the stupid guide!
I hate Laphines!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
这都是那个
蠢向导害的！
我讨厌拉菲尼！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is all because of
the stupid guide!
I hate Laphines!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
这都是那个
蠢向导害的！
我讨厌拉菲尼！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
That thing you have in your hand...
It looks very strange.
I've never seen such a thing before.
You'd better not keep that.
Can I have it?
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你手里拿的那个...
看起来很奇怪。
我从没见过这种东西。
你最好别留着。
可以给我吗？

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 给他。

scripts.text: Don't give it to him.
scripts.translation: 不给他。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So I swallow it like this,
and voila! Evidence gone!
Now I can sleep soundly, thank you!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我就这样吞下去，
瞧，证据没了！
这下我总算能睡个安稳觉了，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
Why are you showing me such a thing?
I don't know anything! I'm the victim here!
I'm a victim of the schemes of the Laphine couple.
It's unfair...
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你给我看这个干什么？
我什么都不知道！我才是受害者！
我被那对拉菲尼夫妇算计了。
这太不公平了...

scripts.text:
It's no use trying to talk to him any more.
Try talking to Euridi.
scripts.translation:
再跟他说也没用了。
去和尤里迪谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
This is unfair!
This is so totally unfair!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
这不公平！
简直太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
What are you, a professional mover?
Stomping about with a ton of stuff on your back!
I can't rest because of the noise!
Throw away all that stuff!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
你是搬家公司的？
背着一大堆东西到处走，吵得我没法休息！
把那些东西都扔了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I never imagined you'd find them all
and piece them together.
Is this a divine punishment...?
Or Laphines' curse?
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我真没想到你能把线索全找齐，还拼了起来。
这是神明的惩罚吗...？
还是拉菲尼的诅咒？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
That guide fellow,
he opened the gate out
when he was hit hard
by the poison.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
那个向导...
中了剧毒后，
把出口的门打开了。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
When I was hesitating whether to take him with me,
he handed me that letter and the ring.
Laphines' jewelry...
It's rumored that nobody could ever have it except Laphines,
including the Gods themselves.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我还在犹豫要不要带他走，他就把信和戒指交给了我。
那是拉菲尼的饰品...
传闻说，除了拉菲尼，谁也得不到它，连神明都不例外。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
So I had in my hands
a treasure among treasures!
How...! Just how on earth
could I have let it pass through!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
也就是说，珍宝中的珍宝
曾经就在我手里！
我怎么...到底怎么会
让它从手边溜走！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I was going to leave this place
as soon as I pulled myself together.
But now I'm stuck here,
affected by the poison myself.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我本来想等缓过劲就离开这里。
没想到现在也中了毒，被困住了。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I'll give you the ring back,
so please leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
戒指还给你，
求你别再烦我了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then where could Lope...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那洛佩他...会在哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
If he died near the exit of the forest,
he must be somewhere around there,
in whatever form he might be in.
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
如果他死在森林出口附近，
应该就在那一带，
只是不知道变成什么样子了。

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
I'm a victim, too!
So leave me alone! I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[皮特]
我也是受害者！
求你别再管我了！

scripts.text:
[Pitt]
...

He's sleeping.
He seems to be in a very deep sleep.
scripts.translation:
他睡着了。
看起来睡得很沉。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Aaaarrrrrggggghhhh!!!!!!
I can't see anything.
Who's there?
Answer, or I'll take you as an enemy and kill you.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊啊啊啊！！！
我什么都看不见。
谁在那里？
快回答，不然我就把你当成敌人杀了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Euridi is looking for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尤里迪在找你。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Wraith, how can you be so harsh to me?
I asked you to wipe the name off my mind
in return for bearing the curse!
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
恶灵，你怎么能这么狠心？
我答应承受诅咒，
就是为了让你抹去我记忆中的那个名字！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Will you please calm down and listen to...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你先冷静下来，听我说...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
My desire to help
led me to my death,
And my desire to survive and take revenge
led me to my rebirth.
I will not side with life any more.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
我想帮助别人，
却因此丧命；
我渴望活下去、渴望复仇，
才因此重生。
我再也不站在生者那边了。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
As soon as my transformation is over,
I will punish you all with the bloody confusion of the Hazy Forest,
which saved my life!
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
等我彻底变身，
就要用救了我一命的迷雾森林，
以血腥的混乱惩罚你们所有人！

scripts.text: You put the letter Euridi pieced together in Lope's hands.
scripts.translation: 你把尤里迪拼好的信交到洛佩手中。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
...This is!
I feel Euridi's touch.
So the letter... was delivered to Euridi?
This is unbelievable...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
...这是！
我感受到了尤里迪的触碰。
所以...这封信送到尤里迪手上了？
简直难以置信...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Deformed as I am now,
I'm not her love any more.
Go back, and tell her that Lope turned to dust
on the ground of the Hazy Forest long ago.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
我如今已经面目全非，
不再是她爱着的那个人。
回去告诉她，洛佩早已化作尘土，
长眠在迷雾森林里。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Now go!
This is my last request as a Laphine called Lope...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
快走吧！
这是我以拉菲尼洛佩之名提出的最后请求...

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Deformed as I am now,
I'm not her love any more.
Go back, and tell her that Lope turned to dust
on the ground of the Hazy Forest long ago.
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
我如今已经面目全非，
不再是她爱着的那个人。
回去告诉她，洛佩早已化作尘土，
长眠在迷雾森林里。

scripts.text:
[Lope]
Now go!
This is my last request as a Laphine called Lope...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩]
快走吧！
这是我以拉菲尼洛佩之名提出的最后请求...

scripts.text: You see a ring glowing faintly on his left hand.
scripts.translation: 你看见他左手上的戒指正微微发光。

scripts.text: I see a suspicious man. Should I try talking to him?
scripts.translation: 我看到一个可疑的男子。要试着和他谈谈吗？

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 别管他。

scripts.text: Talk to him.
scripts.translation: 和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
.
...
........!!!

[Suspicious Man]
Aaaaarrrrrggghh!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
......
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...

scripts.text:
^FF0000- Warning message -
- Hang on there!! -
- You have too many items -
- to receive any more items. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000- 警告 -
- 等一下！！ -
- 你携带的物品太多， -
- 无法再领取物品。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后重试。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Don't humans sleep?
People should be sleeping at this hour.
Why on earth are you bothering me?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
人类也不睡觉吗？
这个时间早该睡了。
你们到底来烦我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I can't get any sleep because of you.
I have to sleep for my research tomorrow.
You should go sleep too.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
被你们吵得我睡不着。
明天还要做研究，我得好好睡一觉。
你也该去睡了。

scripts.text: Z z Z z
scripts.translation: Z z Z z

scripts.text: ^FF0000He appears to be asleep.^000000

[Raffle Researcher]
Oh no~ My research tools...
What...... What was it?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
哎呀~我的研究工具...
那...那是什么来着？

scripts.text: What is your business here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里有什么事？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're human...? Are you human...?
You... came from the underworld?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你是人类...？真的是人类？
你...从冥界来的？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Human beings are incredible...
You survived the crevice and made it here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
人类真不可思议...
你居然穿过裂缝来到了这里。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
You, come here for a minute.
It's a simple experiment, so there's no need to be afraid.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
喂，过来一下。
只是个简单的实验，不用害怕。

scripts.text: What a crazy Raffle. I must run away.
scripts.translation: 这个拉弗尔疯了，我得赶紧逃。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You said you had made it up from the Crevice,
so I was wondering what race you were,
but a mere human? How did you get up here?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你说自己是从裂缝爬上来的，所以我还在想你是什么种族...
没想到只是个人类？你是怎么上来的？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
What... I thought a human who made it up from the Crevice
would be extraordinary,
but you're no more than a kid.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
什么...我还以为能从裂缝爬上来的人类一定不简单，
结果只是个小鬼。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go hunt more ^000000Porings^000000
and come back when your level is in the triple digits kid!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
^000000多去打些波利^000000，等等级升到三位数再回来，小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
... ... ...

[Raffle Researcher]
You... You're not like the other humans.
You're not running away...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你...你跟其他人类不一样。
你没逃跑...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You've got some serious guts...
Now I really want to do some experiments on you...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
胆子不小嘛...
我现在更想拿你做实验了...

scripts.text: Well... that's... um...

[Raffle Researcher]
Ha ha... Just kidding...
I'm a Raffle researcher,
but I don't research humans.
Actually, I have no idea
what to research
about humans...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
哈哈...骗你的...
我虽然是拉弗尔研究员，
但不研究人类。
其实我也不知道
人类有什么好研究的...

scripts.text: Glad to hear that...
scripts.translation: 听你这么说我就放心了...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
That's that. You're not busy, are you?
I'd like you to give me a hand...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
那个...你现在有空吗？
我想请你帮个忙...

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮他。

scripts.text: Help willingly.
scripts.translation: 爽快地答应帮忙。

scripts.text: Although you feel a little embarrassed, help anyhow.
scripts.translation: 虽然有点不好意思，还是帮忙吧。

scripts.text: Help with conviction.
scripts.translation: 坚定地答应帮忙。

scripts.text: Help adorably.
scripts.translation: 可爱地答应帮忙。

scripts.text: You're suspicious, but help anyhow.
scripts.translation: 虽然觉得可疑，还是帮忙吧。

scripts.text: You have no choice. Help him.
scripts.translation: 没办法，只好帮他。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I haven't met many humans
but you clearly care about
another person's hardship.
You must be an ^FF0000extremely^000000 nice human.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我没见过多少人类，
不过你显然很关心别人的困境。
你一定是个^FF0000特别^000000善良的人类。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'll save my thanks for time's sake.
It's important, so please take care of it quickly.
I can't proceed with the research because of it.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
时间紧迫，我就不多谢了。
这件事很重要，请尽快处理。
不然我的研究就进行不下去了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Here at the Mora Inn,
there's a very famous bath.
If anybody, not just us Raffles,
goes into the bath water
their wounds will be healed instantly...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
穆拉旅馆里有个非常有名的浴池。
不只是我们拉弗尔人，任何人只要泡进池水里，
伤口都会立刻愈合...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
So being a great researcher, I went into the bath
to check it out further
and... unfortunately...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
身为优秀的研究员，我当然要亲自下去
好好调查一番...可惜...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I was attacked by a mysterious creature,
and I lost consciousness.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我被一种神秘生物袭击，
当场失去了意识。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
When I woke up, I realized that
my important research tools were missing...
So I was at a loss for what to do.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
醒来后，我发现
重要的研究工具不见了...
真让我不知所措。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
And here you are, a human,
a brave, heroic human that arrived at Mora Village from the Crevice.
Your willingness to help has really taken this load off of my mind.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
就在这时，你出现了。你是个勇敢又了不起的人类，从裂缝一路来到穆拉村。
你愿意帮忙，真让我松了一大口气。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Please go to the bath house and retrieve my research tools.
The sooner you get them back,
the sooner I can get back to my research.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
请去浴场找回我的研究工具。
你越快拿回来，
我就越早能继续研究。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Have a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
一路小心。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're back? Where are my research tools?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你回来了？我的研究工具呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't found the research tools?
I'm disappointed. Get yourself to the bath
and quickly retrieve my research tools
taken away from me.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
还没找到研究工具吗？真让我失望。快去浴场，把被偷走的工具找回来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Wow!! You found the research tools...?
You're quite capable.
I really like how you handle your work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
哇！！研究工具找到了...？
你真能干。
我很欣赏你办事的效率。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I like you.
Do you want to work on my research with me?
I could use your help here and there,
until I'm done with this research.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我挺喜欢你的。
愿意和我一起做研究吗？
在研究结束之前，我会不时需要你帮忙。

scripts.text: As you wish.
scripts.translation: 听你的。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Great. Thanks, and when we're done,
I'll pay you handsomely.
Also, for every research project that's completed,
I'll also give you some pocket money.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
太好了，谢谢你。等研究完成，我会给你丰厚的报酬。
每完成一项研究，我也会另外给你些零用钱。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Young Raffles these days... they are just plain stupid.
I've always wanted a capable research assistant,
but it hasn't been easy to find one.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
现在的年轻拉弗尔...真是蠢得可以。
我一直想找个能干的研究助手，可惜不容易。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
By the way... Was it that difficult to
reclaim the research tools?
You're carrying some very heavy looking equipment.
Go lighten your load, and I'll pay you for your work.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
对了...找回研究工具很费劲吧？
看你带着一堆沉甸甸的装备。
先去减轻负重，我再付你报酬。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
It must've been hard work to retrieve the tools.
Why don't you take this and go to the inn
and rest up? There's nothing for you to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
找回工具肯定费了不少劲。
拿着这个去旅馆休息一下吧。眼下没什么事要你做。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
It must've been hard work to retrieve the tools.
Why don't you take this and go to the inn
and rest up? There's nothing for you to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
找回工具肯定费了不少劲。
拿着这个去旅馆休息一下吧。眼下没什么事要你做。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm still preparing for the research.
Unfortunately a few research tools
were damaged.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我还在准备研究。
可惜有几件研究工具坏了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Come to think of it, I don't think
I told you my name.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
说起来，我好像还没告诉你我的名字。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
My name is Inffle. If anybody
asks you who you are working with,
you can say ^0000FFI'm working with Researcher Inffle.^000000
That's why I'm telling you my name.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我叫因弗尔。有人问起你跟谁一起工作，就说：^0000FF“我在协助因弗尔研究员。”^000000
所以我才告诉你我的名字。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Why? The inn is closed?
That's strange, it shouldn't be.
Why don't you go try again?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
什么？旅馆关门了？
真奇怪，不应该啊。
你再去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Darn, I get more worked up the more I think about it.
It's not like I went with bad intentions...
I just wanted to do some research...
Can't believe I got attacked...
I just can't believe it...
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
可恶，越想越生气。
我又不是怀着恶意去的...
只是想做点研究...
结果竟然被袭击了...
真是难以置信...
你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Good thing you're here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
幸好你来了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I've been thinking about
the unidentified creature in the bath.
He's quite the little devil, to take research tools,
which are as important to a researcher as his life...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我一直在想浴池里的那个不明生物。
它竟然拿走了我的研究工具，真是个小恶魔！对研究员来说，那些工具就跟性命一样重要...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
A research assistant's job
is to make sure that the researcher can focus on his research
And not have to worry about anything else... VERY! Important.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
研究助手的工作
就是让研究员能专心研究，
不用操心其他事...这可非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'd like you to take my revenge
on the unidentified creature for me...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我想请你替我
向那个不明生物报仇...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I don't even want anything that drastic.
3 times! Go bully him for just 3 times.
You can draw on his face,
pinch him, tickle him,
whatever you want. Just bully him 3 times.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我也没打算做得太过分。
去欺负它三次就好！
你可以在它脸上画画、
捏它、挠它，
随你怎么做。总之欺负它三次。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
How's the work going?
An assistant has to work swiftly and effectively.
Could it be that you have forgotten
what your task is?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
事情办得怎么样了？
助手就得做事利落、有效率。
你该不会忘了
自己要做什么吧？

scripts.text: Exactly. What should I do?
scripts.translation: 对，我该做什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go bully the unidentified creature
just 3 times.
You can draw on his face,
pinch him, tickle him, or whatever.
Bully him 3 times.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
去欺负那个不明生物三次就好。
可以在它脸上画画、
捏它、挠它，随你怎么做。
欺负它三次。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
So you taught him a lesson? Great. I feel avenged!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你教训过它了？太好了，我总算解气了！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
For a while, I couldn't sleep
because I couldn't stop thinking about the lost research tools.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
之前我一直惦记着丢失的研究工具，
有好一阵子都睡不着。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
That's that! We need to begin the bath research now.
I need to finish the research quickly,
so that I can start on a new topic.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
好了！现在该开始研究浴池了。
我得尽快完成，
好着手新的课题。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Go to the bath water
with the sample tube that I give you,
and gather some samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
拿着我给你的采样管，
去浴池里取些样本。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Look around the bath water,
and you will find an area emitting a distinct aura.
You can collect the samples
from that area.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
在浴池附近找找，
那里有一处散发着特殊气息。
去那里采集样本。

scripts.text:

Why don't you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你的负重太高，我没法把采样管给你。
减轻负重后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Here is the sample tube for collecting.
Go and collect 10 samples!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
这是采样管。
去收集 10 份样本！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Have you collected the samples yet?
Please hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
样本采好了吗？
请抓紧时间。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Look around the bath water,
and you will find an area emitting a distinct aura.
You can collect the samples
from that area.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
在浴池附近找找，
那里有一处散发着特殊气息。
去那里采集样本。

scripts.text:

I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我知道你做了不少事...
可你带的东西实在太多了。
我想给你零用钱也没法给。
减轻负重再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You got the bath water sample. Great job.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
浴池水样采到了。干得好。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'll have to run a few tests
with the bath water samples.
It usually takes about 24 hours.
Why don't you come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我得用这些浴池水样做几项测试。

到时候再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The basic tests have not been completed yet.
There's nothing for you to do now.
Go for a walk.
Spend some money that I gave you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
基础测试还没做完。
现在没什么事要你做。
去散散步，
把我给你的钱花掉吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The basic tests are done.
As I thought...
There were many interesting substances in the bath water.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
基础测试做完了。
果然...
浴池水里含有不少有趣的物质。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The most notable is this unidentifiable DNA.
I didn't have a chance to compare it to a lot of DNA samples,
but I'm pretty sure that this DNA
has been transformed by the mysterious substances of the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
最特别的是这种无法辨识的 DNA。
我还没能拿它和大量 DNA 样本做比较，
但我很确定，这种 DNA
受浴池里的神秘物质影响而发生了变化。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
After much thought,
I concluded that this DNA probably belongs to
the unidentified creature that attacked me.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
经过仔细思考，
我推断这种 DNA 很可能来自
袭击我的那个不明生物。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'd better compare the two.
Please return to the bath
and look for the creature's scales.
If you can, please bring me 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我得把这两种样本比较一下。
请回到浴池，
寻找那只生物的鳞片。
如果可以的话，请带10个回来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'd better compare the two.
Please return to the bath
and look for the creature's teeth.
If you can, please bring me 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我得把这两种样本比较一下。
请回到浴池，
寻找那只生物的牙齿。
如果可以的话，请带10个回来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Haven't you found the unidentified creature's scales yet?
Look carefully!
I'm certain that the creature
dropped his scales somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
还没找到那只身份不明生物的鳞片吗？
仔细找找！
我确定那只生物
把鳞片掉在某个地方了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Haven't you found the unidentified creature's teeth yet?
Look carefully!
I'm certain that the creature
dropped his teeth somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
还没找到那只身份不明生物的牙齿吗？
仔细找找！
我确定那只生物
把牙齿掉在某个地方了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You've collected all the scale samples, finally.
As humans say,
I've been waiting forever for them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
终于收齐所有鳞片样本了。
用人类的话来说，
我等它们等了好久。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You've collected all the tooth samples, finally.
As humans say,
I've been waiting forever for them.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
终于收齐所有牙齿样本了。
用人类的话来说，
我等它们等了好久。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我知道你做了不少事...
可你带的东西实在太多了。
我想给你零用钱也没法给。
减轻负重再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
OK, I'll get to work right away.
If you have any business to attend to, do so.
The DNA analysis takes about 6 hours.
Why don't you go for a walk
and come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
好，我这就开始。
你有其他事要办的话，就先去忙吧。
DNA 分析大约需要 6 小时。
你不妨去散散步，之后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm still analyzing the DNA.
The DNA analysis takes about 6 hours.
Why don't you go for a walk and come back then?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我还在分析 DNA。
大约需要 6 小时。
你去散散步，之后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
This is not it.
The samples that you collected belonged to a normal species.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
不是这个。
你采集的样本属于普通物种。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Must be because so many species of creatures
have been in the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
浴池里去过的生物种类太多，
大概是这个原因。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm sorry, but please re-collect the samples.
This time, the {0}... Yes.
Please bring the {1} samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
抱歉，请重新采集样本。
这次要找{0}...没错。
请把{1}样本带回来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm sorry, but please re-collect the samples.
This time, the scales... Yes.
Please bring the scale samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
抱歉，请重新收集样本。
这次要找鳞片...对。
请把鳞片样本带来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I'm sorry, but please re-collect the samples.
This time, the teeth... Yes.
Please bring the tooth samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
抱歉，请重新收集样本。
这次要找牙齿...对。
请把牙齿样本带来。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Great! These samples are surely
from the mysterious creature.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
太好了！这些样本肯定
来自那个神秘生物。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
According to the analysis,
The DNA is a mutant form of fish DNA.
I'm not sure how long this creature
has lived in the bath,
but this DNA is 70% evolved
from the original fish DNA.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
分析结果显示，
这是变异的鱼类 DNA。
我不知道这种生物
在浴池里生活了多久，
不过它的 DNA 相比原始鱼类 DNA
已经进化了 70%。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Where did this fish come from?
How can it survive in the warm bath water?
After the DNA analysis,
my head is filled with even more questions.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
这条鱼是从哪儿来的？
又是怎么在温热的浴池水里存活的？
分析完 DNA，
我反而有了更多疑问。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
The village elders say
that the bath water comes from
the puddles around the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
村里的长老说，
浴池水来自
村庄四周的水洼。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You are carrying too much weight.
I can't give you the sample tube.
Why don't you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你的负重太高，我没法把采样管交给你。
减轻负重后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If you get me a sample from the puddle
to the east, at 2 o'clock from here,
I'll tell you what to do next.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
请从东边的水洼取一份样本。
从这里看，大约在两点钟方向。
带回来后我再告诉你下一步。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You probably don't need to run around
like you did collecting
the bath water samples.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
这次大概不用像采集浴池水样本时那样
到处奔波。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If you get all 4 puddle samples at once
it may be more convenient. However,
there's the risk of samples being damaged or mixed up.
Therefore, I'm going to send you one place at a time. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
一次收齐 4 份水洼样本会比较方便，不过样本可能损坏或混在一起。
所以我会一次让你采一个地方的样本。祝你顺利。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Go to the puddle to the east of the village,
and collect a sample.
It's going to be at 2 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
还没去采水洼样本吗？
去村子东边的水洼采一份。
就在从这里看两点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the east?
Great job, but it's no time to rest -
the research is almost done.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
东边水洼的样本拿到了？
做得好，不过还不能休息——研究快完成了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You are carrying too much weight.
I can't give you the sample tube.
Why don't you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你的负重太高，我没法把采样管给你。
减轻负重后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Get me a sample from the puddle from the west.
It's not completely to the west...
The puddle should be at 7 o'clock
from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
去西边的水洼取份样本。
不是正西边...
大约在村子的七点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Take care not to damage the sample.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
小心，别弄坏样本。祝你顺利！

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Go to the puddle to the west of the village,
and collect a sample.
It's going to be at 7 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
还没去采水洼样本吗？
去村子西边的水洼采一份。
就在从这里看七点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the west?
Great job, but it's no time to rest -
the research is almost done.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
西边水洼的样本拿到了？
做得好，不过还不能休息——研究快完成了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You are carrying too much weight.
I can't give you the sample tube.
Why don't you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你的负重太高，我没法把采样管给你。
减轻负重后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Get me a sample from the puddle from the south.
The puddle to the south
should be... at 6 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
去南边的水洼取份样本。
南边的水洼应该...在六点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I can't emphasize this enough, even if I did it 1000000000000000000000 times.
Please take care that
the sample is not damaged.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
就算重复一万亿遍也说不完：
务必小心，
别把样本弄坏。

scripts.text:
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Get me a sample from the puddle from the south.
The puddle to the south is located
at 6 o'clock from here.
scripts.translation:
还没去采水洼样本吗？
去南边的水洼取一份样本。
就在从这里看六点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You know what I'm going to say?
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你知道我要说什么吧？
小心点。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You have the sample from the puddle to the south?
Now only the puddle to the north
remains to be sampled.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
南边水洼的样本拿到了？
现在只剩下北边水洼
还没采样。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You are carrying too much weight.
I can't give you the sample tube.
Why don't you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你的负重太高，我没法把采样管给你。
减轻负重后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Please get me the sample from the puddle to the north.
It's not completely to the north.
it's at 11 o'clock from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
请去北边的水洼取样。
不是正北边，
而是在村子的十一点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You know what I'm going to say?
Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你知道我要说什么吧？
小心点。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You still haven't gone to collect the puddle sample?
Please get me a sample from the puddle to the north.
It's not exactly north of the village.
The puddle should be located at 11 o'clock
from the village.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
还没去采水洼样本吗？
请去北边的水洼取一份。
不在村子的正北方，
应该在十一点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You brought the last sample from the puddle from the north.
Great work. You've done really well.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
北边水洼的最后一份样本也带来了。
干得好，做得真不错。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Now, I'm going to do some research
with these samples,
looking at the relationship between
these puddles and the bath.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
现在我要用这些样本
做些研究，
看看水洼和浴池之间
有什么关联。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
I know that you've done a lot...
but you are carrying too many things.
Even though I want to give you pocket money, I can't.
Could you lighten your load and come back?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我知道你做了不少事...
可你带的东西实在太多了。
我想给你零用钱也没法给。
减轻负重再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
If I finish this experiment...
There's probably nothing else to do. While I run the experiment,
why don't you go and entertain yourself?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
等我完成这项实验...
大概就没别的事要做了。趁我做实验时，
你去找点乐子吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Comparison of the samples and the bath water
will take about 12 hours.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
比对样本和浴池水
大约需要 12 小时。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
What? You're here? Well...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
咦？你来了？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
But the sample studies have not been finished.
This is an experiment for the final result,
so don't be too hasty.
I think the research will take about 12 hours.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
样本研究还没完成。
这是决定最终结果的实验，
别太着急。
大概还要 12 小时。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Come back then.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
那之后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're here? Finally,
the experiment results are all in.
Do you want to look at the results?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你来啦？终于，
实验结果都出来了。
想看看结果吗？

scripts.text: Actually, I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 其实我不想看。

scripts.text: Look at the results.
scripts.translation: 看看结果。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Good thinking. Actually, it may hurt
regular people's brains to look at it.
I suppose it's time for your reward
for helping me out so much.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
不看也好。说不定普通人看了会伤脑筋。
你帮了我这么多，
现在该给你奖励了。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
Did I talk to you about the reward before the experiment?
That you won't be sorry that you helped out...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
我实验前是不是说过会给你报酬？
保证不会让你后悔帮忙...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Researcher]
You're curious about the results? Really???
OK, here it is.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗尔研究员]
你真的这么想知道结果？
好吧，给你看。

至于成分...没错，

对我们拉弗尔人或其他种族有致命危险。

而且水的导电率
远高于普通水。
我推测，
这或许就是神秘力量的来源。
目前我是这么认为的。

There is something at work that science cannot explain
in the bath water...
Take the unidentified creature, for instance.
How strange is it that a fish can live
