scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Hmm, you don't look reliable enough to perform tasks for me.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
嗯...你看起来还不够可靠，没法替我办事。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Why don't you come back when you've grown stronger? I can't give you tasks when you're in your current state.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
等你变强些再回来吧。以你现在的实力，我不能把任务交给你。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我现在没有其他任务。以后有新任务，你再来时我会告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Will you please check with ^990099Hotcha^000000
on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
关于上次任务的详情，请去问问^990099霍查^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Welcome.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
欢迎。
我这儿有些任务，你要看看吗？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什么任务？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 告诉我今天的任务。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I'm the Head of the Volunteer Patrol of the Village of Mora. It didn't used to be like this, he he.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我是穆拉村志愿巡逻队的队长。呵呵，以前可不是这样的。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Each day, I'll be giving you a quest to kill off monsters in the surrounding area.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我每天都会交给你一项任务，让你清理周边区域的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
You might get a task that's far too difficult for you to take care of alone - in that case, try to get help from your fellow adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
有时任务太难，你一个人做不完。这种时候就找其他冒险者帮忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Let me see what tasks we've got today... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
让我看看今天有什么任务...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
How about this one?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
这个怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Strange insects that carry fruit on their backs roam this area - you must've seen them.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
这附近有种奇怪的昆虫，背着水果到处跑。你应该见过吧。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I'd like you to take them out as you see them, before they try to sell anything to the adventurers lost in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
看见它们就把它们清理掉，别让它们向迷路的冒险者兜售东西。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
There have been a lot of reports lately about mantises disguised as flowers attacking creatures passing by.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
最近有不少报告说，有些螳螂伪装成花朵，袭击经过的生物。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
No casualties have been reported yet, but it wouldn't hurt to take precautions. Please deal with them appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
目前还没有伤亡，不过提前防范总没错。请妥善处理它们。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
An adventurer was reported to have been attacked by little birds while gathering resources in the vicinity of Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
有冒险者报告说，他在彩虹桥附近采集资源时遭到一群小鸟袭击。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
They didn't look so ferocious... but the adventurer has asked me to get rid of them, so you'll have to do it.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
它们看起来并不凶猛...不过既然冒险者拜托我清理它们，就交给你处理吧。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I have qualms about this one, but somebody anonymously asked me to hunt down the naughty fairies.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
这件事让我有些为难，不过有人匿名委托我讨伐那些顽皮的妖精。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
I don't know what grudge he has against the fairies, but a request is a request.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我不知道那人和妖精有什么过节，但既然接了委托就得办。

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
Would you believe it if I said there are balls of blonde hair rolling around? You wouldn't, would you?
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
我说有一团团金发毛球在地上滚，你信吗？肯定不信吧？

scripts.text:
[Elephantine]
They don't seem so dangerous, but they are reported to steal books and sweets from adventurers. Please deal with them appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[象牙]
它们看起来没什么危险，却会偷冒险者的书和糖果。请妥善处理。

[Hotcha]
Hmm, you don't look reliable enough for Elephantine's tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
嗯，你看起来不够可靠，没法完成象牙交代的任务。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
This place is like a paradise for adventurers. Not for weak ones like you, though.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
这里简直是冒险者的天堂...不过可不适合你这种弱者。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
I see you haven't received
any tasks yet.
Go talk to Elephantine,
and Elephantine will give you
one of the countless tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
看来你还没接过任务。
去找象牙谈谈，她会从一大堆任务里挑一个交给你。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
The time is up to complete the existing tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
现有任务的期限到了。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
If you have any unfinished tasks in your quest log, they are considered 'failed' and removed from the log.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
任务日志里还没完成的任务会被视为“失败”，并从日志中移除。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Once they are removed, go talk to Elephantine and you can receive new tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
任务移除后，去找象牙谈谈，就能接新任务了。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Welcome.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
欢迎。
有什么事吗？

scripts.text: I have completed a task.
scripts.translation: 我完成了一项任务。

scripts.text:
Oh.
Have you?
Please wait a minute while I check the documents.
scripts.translation:
哦，真的吗？
请稍等，我查一下记录。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Yes, I see you've completed the task. It has been confirmed as completed.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
嗯，记录显示你已经完成任务，确认无误。

scripts.text:
[Hotcha]
Hmm... {0}.
It may be a documentation error, but according to the documents, you have nothing to do with the tasks.
scripts.translation:
[霍查]
嗯...{0}。
可能是记录出错了，但档案显示你没有接过这些任务。

scripts.text: You have too many kinds of things with you to do that. Throw out some of them and try again.

scripts.translation: 你的负重太高，无法进行操作。减轻负重后再试试。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
I try to give tasks only to reliable people. You are......... no, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我只把任务交给可靠的人。至于你嘛...算了，没什么。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
You really have no clue. What could you do with such a weak body?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
你真是什么都不懂。就你这副瘦弱的身子，能做什么？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
I have no additional tasks available now. If I get some, I'll let you know when you come back.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我现在没有其他任务。有新任务的话，你下次来我会告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Will you please check with the ^990099General Goods Dealer^000000
on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
上次任务的详情，请去找^990099杂货商^000000确认。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Welcome.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
欢迎。
我这里有些任务，你要看看吗？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什么任务？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 说说今天的任务。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Here, we make all kinds of supplies for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我们在这里为冒险者制作各种补给品。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
We accept raw materials for the supplies once a day.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我们每天会收一次制作补给品所需的原材料。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Sometimes, we might ask for materials that are very difficult to obtain. In that case, try to get help from your fellow adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
有时需要的材料很难弄到，遇到这种情况就找其他冒险者帮忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Let me see... what supplies are we making today...?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我看看...今天要做什么补给品呢？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
How about this one?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
这个怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The adventurers here make sure to bring with them, on their exploration to dungeons, a preservative to keep their food fresh. Do you know what the preservative is made from?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
这里的冒险者进地下城探险时，都会带上能让食物保鲜的防腐剂。你知道它是用什么做的吗？

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
*grin* None other than... Insect Feelers! The General Goods Dealer there asked me to get four of them. I personally would not eat it for all the world...
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
*咧嘴一笑* 没错，就是...昆虫触角！那边的杂货商要我弄四根来。要我吃这个？我可敬谢不敏...

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
These days, it's common for adventurers here to make talismans to protect themselves on their dangerous adventures. Like a kind of insurance.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
最近，冒险者都喜欢做护身符，保佑自己冒险平安，就像买了份保险。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Immortal Hearts seem to be all the rage lately. The General Goods Merchant asked me to get five of them.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
最近不死心脏很受欢迎。杂货商要我弄五个。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
They need tons of Rotten Bandages for making first aid bandages. They must have run out of new materials.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
他们要用一大堆腐烂绷带制作急救绷带，看来新材料都用完了。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The client is the General Goods Merchant over there. Three bunches of them will be enough.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
委托人就是那边的杂货商。给他三束就够了。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
Symbols of strong warriors give adventurers great support on their journeys. That's why Orcish Vouchers sell like hotcakes.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
强大战士的象征能给冒险者不少鼓舞，所以兽人战士之证卖得特别好。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Orcish Vouchers, which are to be used to make symbols of courage.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
杂货商要我弄三个兽人战士之证，用来制作勇气护符。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
It seems to be rumored among adventurers that drinking powdered bones mixed with water helps boost their stamina.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
冒险者之间流传着一种说法：把骨头磨成粉泡水喝，能增强体力。

scripts.text:
[Bow-wow]
The General Goods Dealer asked me to get three Skel-Bones, which are to be used to make tonic.
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
杂货商要我弄三根骷髅骨，用来制作补剂。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

on the details of the previous task?
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
关于上次任务的详情，请去对面找^990099日用品商人^000000确认。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Nice to see you.
I have some tasks for you - will you take a look at them?
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]

我这里有些任务，要看看吗？

scripts.text: What kind of tasks do you have for me?
scripts.translation: 你有什么任务？

scripts.text: Tell me about today's task.
scripts.translation: 说说今天的任务。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Bow-wow and I are in the same industry.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我和汪汪做的是同一行。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
We are a manufacturer of adventurers' supplies.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我们专门制作冒险者用品。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
My tasks won't be easy - you'd better prepare yourself.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我的任务可不轻松，你最好做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Hmm... What tasks are at hand today?
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
嗯...今天有什么任务呢？

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Oh. This one looks good.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
哦，这个不错。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Some people just hang their talismans around their necks, but more people choose to seal them in special cases and carry them on their bodies.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
有人把护身符挂在脖子上，也有更多人把它们封进特制的小盒子里，随身带着。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Mementos serve as inspirations for designers of those cases. The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two of them.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
纪念品能给护符盒的设计师带来灵感。对面的日用品商人要我弄两个。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Adventurers make sure to keep their talismans safe, because they could save their lives.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
冒险者都会把护身符收好，毕竟关键时刻能救命。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me seems to make protective cases out of Shells. I was asked to get three of them.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人似乎想用贝壳做护符盒，让我去弄三个。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
Adventurers that go into the bushes of the Maze of the Hazy Forest always wear knee protectors.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
进入迷雾森林迷宫的灌木丛时，冒险者都会戴上护膝。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get three Scale Shells, which are to be used to make knee protectors.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人让我弄三片鳞片外壳，用来制作护膝。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
I have a task for you at hand, making a vaccine for possible poisonous insects.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
我有个任务要交给你：制作一种对付毒虫的疫苗。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]
The Commodities Dealer across from me asked me to get two Venom Canines, which are to be used in the research of the substance.
scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人让我弄两颗毒牙，用来研究这种药剂。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]

scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
看来他们用来给鞋底防滑的材料用完了。

scripts.text:
[Woof-grrr]

scripts.translation:
[呜汪]
对面的日用品商人委托我弄五团黏稠液体。

Reliability is the primary quality needed in looking for lost souls. You don't look so reliable to me.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: ^660066Age 32. Comes from Midgard. Has been missing for 3 months since he went to the Maze of the Hazy Forest in order to collect the native plants. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄 32 岁，来自米德加尔特。三个月前为采集当地植物进入迷雾森林迷宫，此后失踪。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 19. Adventurer who came from a far, unknown place by ship. Been missing for 2 months since he went to explore the Maze dressed in thin tights, despite dissuasion of all Mora residents.
Even if he's alive, he would cause trouble to the rescue team.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄 19 岁，是一名乘船从遥远未知之地来的冒险者。两个月前，他不顾穆拉居民劝阻，穿着单薄的紧身衣进入迷宫探险后失踪。
就算还活着，也会给救援队添麻烦。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age unknown. Has some mental illness. Went alone in order to purify the Maze of the Hazy forest. He insists that he has good ancestry but no one trusts him.
Disappearance period : 12 years. Not much chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄不详，患有精神疾病。独自进入迷雾森林迷宫，声称要净化那里。他坚称自己出身名门，却没人相信。
失踪时间：12 年。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 51. Used to be a big thief who stole famous swords from all around the world.
Went missing in the Maze after being pursued for running an illegal casino house which caused massive casualties in his final years. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄 51 岁，曾是名震四方的大盗，专门偷窃各地名剑。
晚年因经营非法赌场、造成大量伤亡而遭到追捕，之后在迷宫中失踪。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 22. An apprentice of an airship pilot. He has gone missing while drinking in Mora town, where he went for a break.
Rumor has it that he fled after signing somewhere. Disappearance period : 4 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄 22 岁，是飞空艇驾驶员的学徒。他去穆拉镇休假时喝酒后失踪。
据说他在某处签了字，随后便逃走了。失踪时间：4 个月。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age Unknown. A female with long hair, dressed in black. Went on an expedition to the forest of the Maze in search of eternal life. Disappearance period : 3 months. Low chance of survival.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄不详，女性，留着长发，身穿黑衣。为了寻找永生，她进入迷雾森林探险。失踪时间：3 个月。生还几率极低。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age around 50. The current Mayor of the Mora village. He ran away to the Forest of Maze after being caught pocketing profits by cheating the residents. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄约 50 岁，是穆拉村现任村长。因被发现欺骗村民、中饱私囊而逃进迷雾森林迷宫。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text:
^660066Age 29. A young man with an unknown background.
Fled to the forest of maze after scamming 1200 Mora coins from Mora residents while pretending to start a lot of business and adapting himself in Mora. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation:
^660066年龄 29 岁，背景不明的年轻男子。
他谎称要在穆拉创业、融入当地，骗走村民 1,200 枚穆拉村硬币后逃进迷雾森林迷宫。生死不明。^000000

scripts.text: ^660066Age 34. Flirted with several women in Mora. Fled from Mora villagers to the forest of maze. Survival uncertain.^000000
scripts.translation: ^660066年龄 34 岁，曾在穆拉勾搭多名女性，之后被村民追赶着逃进迷雾森林迷宫。生死不明。^000000

I don't know whether to believe this art dealer... He made me stand here like this for days.... Ah... I feel dizzy.

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Chief]
We are the legendary order of the Neighborhood Knights, founded just five minutes ago!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团长]
我们是传奇的邻里骑士团，五分钟前才刚成立！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Chief]
We have four chiefs but no foot soldiers...
It's so frustrating!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团长]
我们有四个首领，却连一个小兵都没有...
真叫人头疼！

scripts.text:
[Other Leaders]
Those other guys are all soldiers, but I'm the Boss!
I, the Head, will tell you what to do!
The Leader is the highest in the rank!
You talked me into joining the order, and now look at this!
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
那些家伙全是士兵，只有我是老板！
我可是头目，当然该由我发号施令！
领袖才是最高职位！
你当初劝我加入骑士团，现在看看这烂摊子！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
We've run out of Mora Coins.
Come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
穆拉村硬币用完了。
明天再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
You have a lot of things with you!
Why not dump some of them in my pocket?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
你带的东西可真多！
要不要放几样到我口袋里？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
So you've brought back
200 ^FF0000Mysterious Seeds^000000.
Are you working under my command?
I'm so confused
because I've been sending random people on errands.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
你带回了 200 颗^FF0000神秘种子^000000啊。
你是听我指挥办事的吗？
我都糊涂了，
最近一直随便找人跑腿。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
I'll reward you as I promised.
You made sure everyone knows
it's the Order of the Neighborhood Knights's work, right?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
我会照约定给你奖励。
你有让大家知道
这是邻里骑士团的功劳吧？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
You have courage to
show up out of nowhere
and demand Mora Coins... how impressive!
You're more than qualified to be a soldier of the Order of the Neighborhood Knights.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
你竟敢突然冒出来
开口要穆拉村硬币...胆子真不小！
你完全够资格加入邻里骑士团，当一名士兵。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
Soldier, I need you to do something for me.
Go to the Hazy Forest and gather 200 ^FF0000Mysterious Seeds^000000!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
士兵，我有件事要交给你。
去迷雾森林收集 200 颗^FF0000神秘种子^000000！

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 遵命！

scripts.text: I challenge you to a duel!
scripts.translation: 我要向你挑战！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
Good attitude, {0} Soldier!
I'll reward you handsomely when you get back.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
干劲不错，{0}士兵！
等你回来，我会好好奖励你。

scripts.text:
[Other Bosses]
This is from me, the Chief!
Don't look down on the Head!
It's from me, the Leader!
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
这是我首领的命令！
别小看头目！
这是我领袖的决定！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Boss]
See the Chief if you want to have a duel!
I'm in charge of recruiting here.
Ahem...
scripts.translation:
[骑士团首领]
想决斗就去找首领！
我负责招募。
咳咳...

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
You have a lot of things with you!
Why not dump some of them in my pocket?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
你带的东西可真多！
要不要放几样到我口袋里？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I hear that a Laphine called 'Lope'
went missing in the Hazy Forest.
I wish the Order of the Neighborhood Knights
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
听说有个叫“洛佩”的拉菲尼
在迷雾森林失踪了。
我希望邻里骑士团

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
could help solve the case,
but we can't now
because we're not done cleaning the yard yet.
So, what I'm trying to say is
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
能帮忙查清这件事，
可我们现在抽不开身，
院子还没打扫完呢。
所以我的意思是...

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
why don't you go
and deal with the problem
on behalf of the Order of the Neighborhood Knights!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
你何不代表邻里骑士团，
去把这件事处理一下？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I promise, as the Head of the Order,
that I'll give you more work
when you get back!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
我以骑士团团长的身份保证，
你回来后还有更多工作等着你！

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I approve it, as the Chief.
You can thank me, the Boss.
You know the Leader is the boss here, right?
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
我以首领的身份批准了。
你该感谢我这个老板。
这里可是领袖说了算，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So the missing Laphine
is dead?
I'm sorry to hear that.
I could have saved him.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
所以那位失踪的拉菲尼
已经死了吗？
真遗憾。
我本来可以救他的。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
I hear that there are more ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000
in the Hazy Forest.
Go look for the rest of them
and bring back about 30 of them.
They will make great souvenirs.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
听说迷雾森林里还有更多^0000FF洛佩的线索^000000。
去把剩下的找来，
带回大约 30 份。
可以当作不错的纪念品。

scripts.text: Am I doing all the work here or what?
scripts.translation: 难道一直都是我在做事吗？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 遵命！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So you've noticed it?
Darn! I should have given you work earlier!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
原来你看出来了？
可恶！我早该早点给你派活！

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
It was worthwhile to have trained you after all.
I'm proud of you,{0} Soldier!
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
看来训练你没白费。
我为你骄傲，{0}士兵！

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I think you'll make a great right-hand man, the Chief.
I feel rewarded, as the Boss.
As the Leader, I'm so pleased to see you all improve.
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
我觉得你会成为首领的得力助手。
作为老板，我很欣慰。
身为领袖，看到你们进步我真高兴。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
You still haven't gathered
^0000FFLope's Clues^000000?
I feel somewhat good,
because that's about what I expected out of you.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
你还没找到^0000FF洛佩的线索^000000？
我倒是松了口气，
毕竟也没指望你能找到。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
So you've brought back ^0000FFLope's Clues^000000.
Let's see ...
Assemble, assemble
Attach, attach
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
你把^0000FF洛佩的线索^000000带回来了啊。
我看看...
拼起来，拼起来...
接上，接上...

scripts.text:
[Lope's Letter]
...a traveler... attacked...
...under disguise... deadly poison...
...the Village... in danger...
scripts.translation:
[洛佩的信]
...一个旅行者...遭到袭击...
...伪装身份...致命毒药...
...村庄...有危险...

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
What on earth does this mean?
Well done, anyway.
Cheer up, you will be a great head of the Knights like myself, someday.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
这到底是什么意思？
不管怎样，干得不错。
振作起来，总有一天你也能成为像我这样了不起的骑士团团长。

scripts.text:
[Other Heads]
I'm not so sure!
It's too much for us.
It's no use trying to do it.
scripts.translation:
[其他首领]
我可不这么觉得！
这件事我们应付不来。
怎么做都没用。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
We're in trouble.
We're sick of being knights.
We're thinking of forming
a circus troupe instead.
Are you interested in trying tightrope walking?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
我们有麻烦了。
当骑士真没意思。
我们打算改行组个马戏团。
你想来走钢丝吗？

scripts.text: Well, I could do a fire show.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以表演火焰秀。

scripts.text: This is so absurd.
scripts.translation: 这也太荒唐了。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
No, it's impossible.
I burned down a few houses
playing with fire.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
不行，绝对不行。
我玩火时烧掉过好几栋房子。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Head]
That's the answer I expected.
I'm proud of myself.
scripts.translation:
[骑士团团长]
这答案正合我意。
我真为自己骄傲。

scripts.text:
[Order of the Knights Leader]
I'm the Leader of the Order -
you can tell me.
What brings you here? Do you have some work for us?
scripts.translation:
[骑士团领袖]
我是骑士团领袖——
有话尽管说。
你来这里做什么？想委托我们办事吗？

scripts.text:
[Other Leaders]
Huh! I said the Boss is the boss!
No, the Chief is the best!
How rude you all are! I'm the Head here!
scripts.translation:
[其他领袖]
哼！我说老板才是老大！
不对，首领最厉害！
你们真没礼貌！这里我才是团长！
